Background: This randomized phase 2 trial compared CAPOX plus bevacizumab with FOLFOXIRI plus bevacizumab in 600 patients with previously untreated BRAF V600E-mutant metastatic colorectal cancer.
Results: The objective response rate was 26.1% in the CAPOX plus bevacizumab arm versus 55.1% in the FOLFOXIRI plus bevacizumab arm. Median progression-free survival was 4.5 months versus 9.3 months (hazard ratio 1.59; 95% CI 1.51 to 1.71). Median overall survival was 19.9 months versus 32.8 months. Grade 3 or higher adverse events occurred in 28% versus 68% of patients.
